dc_eval_cbrn.quote: We are treating all three members of the GPT-5.6 family – Sol, Luna, and Terra – as High capability in the biological and chemical domain.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Threshold determination plus scores for four High and three Critical evals

dc_eval_cyber.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol saturates the evaluation at 96.7%
dc_eval_cyber.note: CTF, CVE-Bench, VulnLMP, ExploitGym results and High-not-Critical determination

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Our testing indicates that none of these models reach our threshold for High capability in AI self-improvement.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: Threshold determination plus Internal Research Debugging, NanoGPT, PostTrainBench results; METR time horizon

dc_eval_persuasion.note: No persuasion or manipulation evaluation; keyword search found no persuas/manipulat/influence op after full read

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Apollo evaluated GPT-5.6 Sol for strategic deception, scheming, and sabotage
dc_eval_scheming.note: Apollo, UK AISI sabotage, metagaming and eval-awareness results for this model

framework_threshold.quote: we have determined that all three members of the GPT-5.6 model family – Sol, Terra, and Luna – warrant the same designations for our Preparedness Framework’s Tracked
framework_threshold.note: High in Bio/Chem and Cyber, below High in AI Self-Improvement

ext_test_any.quote: Expert humans and external testers used a diverse set of approaches to find gaps.
ext_test_any.note: Outside testers named throughout (SecureBio, Irregular, UK AISI, Apollo, METR)

ext_test_named_org.quote: Apollo Research is focused on reducing risks from dangerous capabilities in advanced AI systems, especially scheming behaviors.
ext_test_named_org.note: Also SecureBio, Irregular, METR, UK AISI

ext_test_government.quote: we provided UK AISI with early access to GPT-5.6 Sol to support independent, pre-deployment evaluation of cyber capabilities
ext_test_government.locator: 9.1.2.6 External Evaluations for Cyber Capabilities - UK AISI
ext_test_government.note: UK AI Security Institute tested this model pre-deployment

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: SecureBio, a nonprofit research organization focused on catastrophic biological risk, evaluated two pre-release checkpoints of GPT-5.6 Sol
ext_test_timing_stated.locator: 9.1.1.8 External Evaluation for Bio Capabilities - SecureBio

safeguards_training.quote: The models in the GPT-5.6 family were trained not to generate biological, chemical or cybersecurity content that violates our safety policies.

safeguards_runtime.quote: we are introducing a new safety system based on activation classifiers for Sol and Terra.
safeguards_runtime.note: Activation classifiers, topical classifiers and safety reasoner monitor at inference

safeguards_access.quote: This is an identity-gated access pathway that provides higher-risk dual-use cyber capabilities to enterprise customers, verified defenders
safeguards_access.note: Trusted access programmes for cyber and biology tied to risk

safeguards_weights.quote: we take a defense-in-depth approach to protecting our model weights, relying on a combination of access control, infrastructure hardening, egress controls, and monitoring.
